notes:
ISS2000 PC Port NC 1.0.0 - 8 November 2026

Changes since 0.9.9:
- Reports now open File Explorer with the ZIP selected: send that file to me. The launcher also has an Open reports folder button.
- Reports include the latest game sessions from this version even when the PC clock is wrong, warn if none are found, and include the processor model and core counts.
- Team flags show the complete image in Select Teams, pre-match summaries and the scoreboard; the selection panel light stays smooth and summary flags survive dialogs and menu transitions.
- The owner's original Euro Stars, Asia Stars, Africa Stars, All America Stars and World Stars artwork is included. Unchanged ROM-generated files migrate automatically when you start the game; customised files are kept. Euro Stars B remains generated from your own ROM.
- Physical Rumble Pak / Controller Pak swap prompts are skipped on PC after the real controller checks. Saving, loading and rumble still use the normal PC services.
